intent.caption: Gradient CTA object — A primary CTA as a physical object: engineered gradient ramp, press-down state, accent edge light (DL12).

visualSpec.effects: Rounded-rect button plane 2.6w x 0.68h scene units, corner radius 0.08, extruded bevel depth 0.03 with 45deg chamfer that catches the key light as a bright machined edge; face carries a vertical engineered gradient #ff4450 (at 0.0) -> #ff2a38 (at 0.55) -> #c1121f (at 1.0) with one hard 0.01-unit seam line at 50 percent face height, zero soft blur; material roughness 0.5, metalness 0.35, clearcoat 0.22; perimeter emissive channel 0.015 units wide in #ff2a38 at intensity 1.6; label centered with 0.25-unit side padding (1x base unit), caption line 0.25 below the button in paper; mount motion weighted-settle scale 1.04 -> 1.0 over 900ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1); hover translateZ 0 -> 0.06 and edge emissive intensity 1.6 -> 2.2 over 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); press scale 1.0 -> 0.97 over 120ms cubic-bezier(0.175,0.885,0.32,1.275) while the chamfer shadow visibly deepens under the raking key light; contact shadow plane 0.08 below at 35 percent opacity that tightens on press.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Button settles with 1.04 overshoot on mount; hover lifts 0.06 units toward camera with brighter edge glow; press compresses to 0.97 scale.
sceneSpec.contrastMinimum: 4.8:1 ink label #16161d on accent gradient midpoint #ff2a38; 4.5:1 minimum all text; caption #e8ecf2 on #0b0b10 exceeds 15:1
